name: support-commas-in-names
description: CLI list options split their values on commas, so a file path or spec id containing a comma becomes two names that do not exist. Names must survive intact: lists carry whole names and every host passes arrays to the use cases. Also hardens spec ID handling in dependency commands: IDs are really validated (empty or malformed values are rejected), changes deps gains --clear, and an invalid persisted spec-lock fails with an actionable error that the CLI can repair.
